messages:
maya: FYI I opened a PR to add Acadia-13B (int8 Q4) to the model catalog. It has an updated limits table, brief migration notes, and compact SDK examples. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/5078
frank: nice. did you include bench numbers and the hardware for the limits table?
kevin: ran quick profiles on a100-80g: p50 generate ~41ms for 512 tokens (batch=4), steady throughput ~150 tok/s (batch=8). memory resident ~44GB with int8 Q4. csv: https://gist.github.com/kevin/acadia-5078-bench
sam: link checker flagged a broken relative link in the migration section `../models/acadia.md` -> 404. use canonical `/models/acadia` or doc slug helper.
link-bot: Link check failed: /docs/models/acadia -> 404
maya: thanks — switched links to `/models/acadia` and added a redirect note in the PR. also added a short "runtime compatibility" row.
frank: please be explicit: `Runtime < 3.1: int8 artifacts (KV layout v2) not supported; requests will automatically fall back to Acadia-13B-fp16.` short and clear.
kevin: add a tiny note comparing fp16 vs int8 quality: we observed minor output variance (~2-6%) and tokenization deltas; recommend running a small eval set during migration.
maya: added a short "known diffs" bullet and the suggestion to pin `model: 'acadia-13b-fp16'` for parity testing. included a curl example for quick smoke tests:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"acadia-13b-int8","input":"hello world"}'
```
sam: LGTM from a content perspective, will do a final read tomorrow morning.
staging-bot: docs build completed. staging preview: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/models/acadia (expires in 48h)
maya: thanks all — will merge after sam approves and then post a short note in #release-war-room.
